skillset.skill: 14s CT - 3000% Light DMG (PHY). Increase own Arts by 10. From the second use of Skill onwards, each time Skill is used, increase own Arts by an additional 10 (MAX: 300).
skillset.arts: 25000% Light DMG (PHY). For 20s, reduce enemies' Break RES and PHY RES by 30%.
skillset.truearts: 60000% Light DMG (PHY). For 25s, allies gain a DMG barrier that negates 8000 DMG and increase allies' DMG RES by 30%.
skillset.superarts: 300000% Light DMG (PHY). Ignore enemies' DEF by 100% for the duration of Super Arts.

passive.ability2: Increase own DMG by [3% x own ATK/100].
passive.ability3: Increase own Status ailment RES by 100%.
passive.ability4: Unit EXP UP 20% UP. (When Saitama the Hero's SP. Art is owned)
passive.ability5: At the Start of Quest, increase own Arts gauge by 10. Does not stack with Abilities of the same name. (When Saitama the Hero's SP. Art is owned)
